items.summary: NASA's Voyager 1 has phoned home from one light-day away, humanity's first emissary to cross this monumental threshold way out in interstellar space.

items.title: Astronomers discover remarkable triple-star system just 28 light-years from Earth
items.summary: Astronomers have discovered a stellar system just 28 light-years from Earth that challenges our understanding of how stars live, die and interact as they evolve.

items.title: Long DNA strands turn chaotic fluid motion into a steady rhythm
items.summary: In living cells, tiny molecules can generate coordinated motion across distances thousands of times larger than the molecules themselves. How such small movements give rise to coordinated motion over much larger distances is still not fully understood.
